4451.about: Two boys of about sixteen or seventeen lie side by side over the back of a sofa in a living room, game controllers in their hands, playing a shooting game on a big television. One pulls a furious face and bares his teeth at the screen while the other laughs. They drop the controllers and start grappling, arms round each other's necks, shouting and laughing, and end up in a hug. The clip cuts to a garden where a group of boys the same age, in shorts and t-shirts, stand barefoot on the grass around a brick oven and a barbecue.
4451.question: What are the two teenagers doing?
4451.answer: They are playing a video game.

4452.about: A young footballer in a white and blue striped shirt sits on a bench in a changing room with his leg pulled up. Low on his shin is a big dark purple mark, and he screws up his face and sucks in his breath as he touches it. A team-mate crouches beside him, points at the mark and winces too, then hands him a blue ice pack. The player presses the ice pack against his shin, flinches and grits his teeth, then holds it there and breathes out slowly while the pain settles.
4452.question: Why is the sitting player holding ice?
4452.answer: He is holding it because his leg hurts.

4454.about: A young man stirs a red bucket of foaming water with a wooden stick beside a car on a drive. The clip cuts to an orchard, where a woman lifts a metal bucket full of red apples, tilts it right over towards the camera and lets the apples pour out and roll all over a wooden picnic table; she then sits behind the scattered fruit and bites into one. In the last scene a man kneels on a beach, turns a striped bucket upside down onto the sand, lifts it away and leaves a sandcastle standing, then throws his arms up.
4454.question: What is the woman doing?
4454.answer: She is tipping the apples onto the table.

4456.about: A man in a green bomber jacket walks along a street past an old red-brick block with washing hung out over its small balconies, and puts his hand on the worn brickwork. He steps back and looks up, and right beside the old block stands a tall new tower of blue-green glass and steel that runs up out of the frame. He walks round to its front, where a smooth curved glass revolving door turns in a flat stone facade, and stares up at the rows of glass panels. The clip ends with him at the foot of an old stone building with tall columns and a heavy wooden door.
4456.question: What is the man looking at?
4456.answer: He is looking at a modern building.

4457.about: On a beach at dusk a young woman in a denim jacket crouches over a fire. The fire is ringed by a circle of big pale blocks of rough natural stone, laid one against the next on the sand to make a low wall around the flames, and their grainy, pitted surfaces are lit up orange by the fire inside. She leans over the stones and feeds thin sticks into the middle, the flames climb up between them, and she sits back on her heels with the stone ring glowing in front of her while the sea and two figures show dark behind.
4457.question: What is the woman doing?
4457.answer: She is crouching by a campfire.

4458.about: A young man in a stained apron stands in a small home kitchen while everything he is cooking goes wrong at once. Two slices of toast, black and smoking, pop up in the toaster in the foreground. He turns to a frying pan of vegetables on the gas hob and pushes them around with a spatula, wincing. Smoke drifts across the room. He opens the oven and a cloud of smoke rolls out around a roasting bird; he flaps a blue-striped tea towel at the smoke, coughing, the kitchen hazy behind him.
4458.question: What is the man waving?
4458.answer: He is waving a towel at the smoke.

4459.about: Evening on a beach, sea and dark headland behind. A woman in a checked shirt sits at a low concrete fire pit holding long skewers of marshmallows over the fire. One marshmallow catches light and burns with a tall orange flame right in front of the camera; she pulls back, laughing and open-mouthed. She lowers the other skewers into the flames, and the fire builds until a column of fire and sparks fills the frame against the dark blue sky.
4459.question: What is burning on the skewer?
4459.answer: A marshmallow is burning on the skewer.

4460.about: A beach at nightfall, the sky already deep blue and the sea barely visible. A woman in a pale jacket crouches over a small teepee of thin sticks ringed with white stones and feeds the little flame at its centre. The fire grows until it is the only light in the shot, throwing orange light onto her face, her hands and the stones while everything beyond stays dark. She sits back on her heels and holds both palms out to the flames as sparks rise.
4460.question: What is the woman in front doing?
4460.answer: She is warming her palms by the fire.

4461.about: A bright beach with blue sea and sky. Two pairs of hands scoop and throw loose sand, working over a body-shaped mound; a pair of bare feet still sticks out at the far end. A hand pats the sand flat along the mound. The camera moves round to the head of the mound, where a grinning young man in sunglasses is buried up to the neck, only his head above the sand. He laughs and talks to the camera while the others keep patting sand around him.
4461.question: What is the man doing?
4461.answer: He is lying buried in the sand.

4462.about: A graveside in a cemetery on a grey day, bare trees and headstones behind. A family in black coats and dark suits stands around an open grave with a pale wooden coffin lowered into it. A woman in a black headscarf steps forward and lays a single white rose on the lid. An elderly man drops a handful of earth onto the coffin. Two workers in overalls shovel soil down onto it from both sides until a mound of brown earth covers the lid, the white rose still on top, while the mourners stand with their heads bowed.
4462.question: What are the mourners attending?

4464.about: A young woman waits at a bus stop in the countryside, leaning against the wooden post of an old timetable sign with green fields and an empty road behind her. She holds an open paperback in both hands and reads it, headphones round her neck, glancing up the road for the bus. The scene cuts to a modern glass bus shelter in a small town in the rain, where she sits on the bench with the book on her lap and points up at the printed timetable on the wall. Finally a blue city bus pulls in and a queue of people, her among them, steps aboard.
4464.question: What is the woman doing?
4464.answer: She is reading a book by the road.

4465.about: A man in a cap with a shoulder bag travels through a city by bus. He waits by the roadside as a small van passes, then steps up into a white city bus through the front door. A red double-decker bus drives past tall glass office towers. He climbs the narrow staircase inside the double-decker up to the open top deck, and at the top he throws both arms wide and shouts with delight as the bus drives on between the skyscrapers.
4465.question: Where is the man going?
4465.answer: He is going upstairs on the bus.

4466.about: A man in a cap and dark T-shirt gets onto one vehicle after another. He climbs into a crowded minibus and squeezes past the other passengers with his bag. He steps up through the doors of a modern city bus and holds a travel card out to the card reader beside the driver. Inside, he stands in the aisle holding the rail while the bus, full of seated passengers, moves off. Then he climbs the steps of a red open-top tour bus, and sits on the top deck with both arms flung wide as the bus drives between skyscrapers.
4466.question: What is the man doing?
4466.answer: He is climbing aboard a red bus.

4468.about: A shopping trip through a covered market street. A hand passes a brown paper bag across while another hand lifts down a coloured mosaic lamp from a display of hanging lanterns. A smiling man in a bright patterned shirt takes the paper bag by its handles in front of stacks of painted plates and tea glasses. Then the camera follows a porter walking away down the narrow lane, carrying an enormous stack on his shoulders and head — rolled rugs, cushions, folded blankets, woven baskets and paper bags piled far above his head — with a silver teapot balanced on top.

phrases.target: the man in the bright shirt
the man in the bright shirt

4468.question: What is the porter doing?
4468.answer: He is carrying a towering pile of rugs.

4470.about: A man in a light blue shirt stands at the white wall units of a bright kitchen with a patterned tile splashback. He opens the doors of an empty cupboard and shows the bare wooden shelves. He then puts the dishes away shelf by shelf: stacks of coloured plates, nests of green and blue bowls, a pile of purple plates lifted up from below. He closes the doors, opens them again, and the cupboard is now full — rainbow stacks of plates and bowls on the lower shelf and rows of coloured preserving jars along the upper one. He steps back and looks at it.
4470.question: What is the man doing?
4470.answer: He is storing plates in the cupboard.

4472.about: A man in a red padded jacket, glasses and a fur hat rides a mountain cable car and cannot believe how high he gets. He grins into the camera inside the crowded cabin, then leans out of the window as the car floats over the tops of tall spruce trees. At a mountain station he walks across the platform to a gondola full of skiers with a sea of cloud behind him. Back inside, he stares open-mouthed out of the window as the cabin travels along a huge snow-streaked rock face, with the valley and further peaks far below.
4472.question: What is the man doing?
4472.answer: He is gaining altitude in a cable car.

4474.about: A woman with red hair spends a morning over coffee and cake. She stands at a café counter under two large black boards headed COFFEE, listing the drinks in two columns with prices beside them, and slides a small glass of espresso on a saucer towards the camera. She then holds a white cup while milk is poured into it from a steel jug, drawing a leaf in the foam, and lifts the finished cappuccino up to the camera with wide eyes. Finally she sits in a grand mirrored café with chandeliers, a silver tray in front of her holding a slice of layered chocolate cake and her coffee, and eats a forkful.

phrases.en: to pour milk into a cup

4474.question: What is the woman eating?
4474.answer: She is eating a piece of chocolate cake.

4476.about: A red-haired woman in a beige turtleneck stands at a coffee bar and knocks back a small espresso, setting the glass down on a saucer. A barista then pours steamed milk into the cup she is holding, drawing a leaf in the foam. The shot opens out into a huge ornate cafe hall with chandeliers, arches, marble tables, a cake trolley and newspapers on a rack, where she sits at a marble table with her cappuccino, smiling and looking around the room.

phrases.en: to pour milk into a cup

4476.question: Where is the woman sitting?
4476.answer: She is sitting in a big hall.

4478.about: A woman in a mustard jumper stands at a white wall next to a window with a big photo calendar hanging on it. She uncaps a red marker, leans in and draws a red ring around one number in the grid, grinning at it. She then scribbles a large cross over the ringed number, and finally turns to the camera beaming and points at the marked day with her finger.
4478.question: What is the woman pointing at?
4478.answer: She is pointing at a date on the calendar.

4479.about: A close shot from the front of a red-haired woman in a black and green cycling jersey riding a spin bike in a packed gym class. She is bent over the handlebars, face red and mouth open, pushing the pedals as fast as she can while other riders work in the rows behind her. She keeps glancing down at the little blue console on the handlebars, and at the end she takes one hand off the bars and claps it to her forehead in disbelief at the number on the screen.
4479.question: What is the woman doing?
4479.answer: She is working hard on her bike.

4481.about: A young woman in a khaki jacket and fingerless gloves photographs her way through a city. She first holds a small silver compact camera up to her eye in front of a flower stall and winks as she takes a shot. She then walks a cobbled street with a big black DSLR round her neck and raises it to her eye, turning the lens barrel with her left hand as a cyclist passes behind her. Finally she crouches behind a huge telephoto lens mounted on a tripod at a viewpoint over the city rooftops, hand on the barrel and eye at the finder, then breaks into a delighted grin.
4481.question: What is the woman doing?
4481.answer: She is focusing her big camera.

4482.about: A woman in a beige parka works her way around an old Italian city taking pictures. She first holds up a small white compact camera in front of a pavement flower stall stacked with buckets of tulips and roses. She then stands in a cobbled street below a stone tower with a black DSLR pressed to her face, taking shot after shot. In the last part she is up on a brick rooftop terrace behind a giant telephoto lens on a tripod, aiming it out over a sea of tiled roofs, then turning to the camera with a delighted laugh.
4482.question: What is the woman doing?
4482.answer: She is shooting the rooftops with a huge lens.

4485.about: A young man in a red checked jacket films himself on a Canadian trip. He first paddles a red canoe across a glassy turquoise lake ringed by snowy peaks. He then stands on a viewing platform in a blue plastic poncho with an enormous waterfall thundering right behind him, the whole curve of it churning white and throwing spray and mist over him while he laughs. Finally he walks through a forest of blazing red and orange maples and holds a single red leaf up to the camera.
4485.question: What is the man holding?
4485.answer: He is holding a red leaf.

4487.about: A young man in a bobble hat and a red checked jacket films himself through a snowy day. He is first out on a frozen pond with a hockey stick, gently taking shots at a small child in an orange jacket who is playing goalie in front of a net. He is next shovelling the snow off a path in front of a house while an elderly woman stands in the doorway waving and calling thanks to him. Finally he is at an outdoor table with a huge stack of pancakes he has made, pouring syrup over it while four delighted children lean in around him with empty plates.
4487.question: What is the man doing?
4487.answer: He is pushing the snow off the path.

4488.about: A large bearded man in a white shirt sits in a busy open-plan office with a telephone handset wedged against his ear. His desk is buried under printed forms and official papers, many of them already marked with big red crosses. He grabs a sheet, slams a rubber stamp down on it and leaves a red X across it, then bangs the stamp onto the ledger in front of him again and again, getting angrier until sheets of paper are flying up all around his head.

phrases.target: the man in the white shirt
the man in the white shirt

phrases.en: to lie in a messy pile

4488.question: What is the angry man doing?
4488.answer: He is slamming a stamp onto a document.

4490.about: A woman in a green dress sits at a long wooden dining table that has already been laid with plates and cutlery. She strikes a match and holds it to the wick of a tall cream candle in a grey holder until it catches. She then works her way down the table lighting one candle after another with the match. In the last shots the room is dark, the whole row of candles is burning down the middle of the laid table, and she sits at the end of it looking down the table and smiling, waiting for her guests.
4490.question: What is the woman doing?
4490.answer: She is lighting the candles on the table.

4495.about: A three-part comparison shot on a suburban street. A young man in a hoodie and jeans leans proudly on the roof of a rusty old brown car while the caption 500 EUR sits over it. Cut to a woman in a business suit unlocking a clean silver saloon, captioned 20,000 EUR. Cut to a red Ferrari with both butterfly doors standing wide open, and a man in a tailored suit strolling up to it, captioned 500,000 EUR.
4495.question: What is the woman doing?
4495.answer: She is opening a car door.

4496.about: A barefoot man in a beige t-shirt and grey joggers stands on the bare wooden floor of a bright open living room. He bends down to a rolled-up patterned rug and pushes it away from him so that it unrolls across the boards. The red and blue rug ends up lying flat in the middle of the room; he walks onto it, then drops onto his back and stretches out on it with his arms out.
4496.question: What is the man doing?
4496.answer: He is laying a rug on the floor.

4498.about: A group of teenagers sit around a low table in a school common room. One boy in a navy hoodie holds out his left arm, which is in a white plaster cast supported by a sling. His friends take coloured felt-tip pens out of a white cup and write their names and messages on the cast, one adding a yellow sun and another a scribbled signature. By the end the cast is covered in names and drawings in green, orange, blue and red, and the boy holds his arm up and laughs at it.
4498.question: What are the friends doing?
4498.answer: They are signing his plaster cast.

4499.about: A red-haired young man in a cream cable-knit jumper and a backpack films himself on a selfie stick as he goes round several castles. He runs up a steep grassy slope towards a stone tower and touches the old wall, laughing. The camera then sweeps through a castle courtyard hung with coloured banners, and finally he walks up a path through trees towards an enormous turreted castle on a hill, grinning back at the camera.
4499.question: What is the man doing?
4499.answer: He is visiting an old castle.

4500.about: A montage of people snatching things out of the air at the last moment. A young woman in a park pulls a falling tennis ball into her chest; a goalkeeper in green throws himself sideways and pins the ball to the grass in front of the goal; a young man in a kitchen shoots out a hand and grabs a plastic bottle before it hits the floor; a woman in a garden takes a whole watermelon out of the air with both hands; a boy lying on the grass stops a huge beach ball above his face with his hands and feet.
4500.question: What is the woman in jeans doing?
4500.answer: She is catching a small ball.

4502.about: Three shots of people looking up at what is above them indoors. A man lies flat on a bed and stares up at a plain white surface with a single bare bulb on a round fitting. A woman on a sofa leans back and looks up at the wooden beams and rafters of a bright open room. A man in a dark suit stands under a huge painted dome inside a grand building, tilting his head back to take in the painted figures and gold panels above him.
4502.question: What is the woman doing?
4502.answer: She is gazing at the wooden beams.

4503.about: A birthday party in a small flat decorated with paper chains, fairy lights and balloons. A woman in a pink dress and a silver party hat stands in the doorway while friends hold a white and black drip cake in front of her and light the row of candles. She closes her eyes for a second, then leans forward and blows the candles out; smoke rises from the cake, everyone throws up their arms and cheers, and her friends crowd in to hug her around the table.
4503.question: What is the woman in pink doing?
4503.answer: She is blowing out the candles.

4504.about: An open-plan office where a team has just hit its target. On a big wall screen a dashboard shows a figure ending in 000, and a man and a woman in front of it throw their arms out at each other in delight. Confetti bursts from the ceiling over the desks; the whole team jumps up from their laptops, high-fives across the tables and hugs, balloons bounce around the room, and at the end they lift a colleague up on their arms while everyone cheers.
4504.question: What is the screen showing?
4504.answer: The screen is showing a number.

4506.about: Three people take a seat, one after another. A young man perches on a hard white kitchen chair, frowning and shifting about as he talks. A woman in a blue shirt sits up straight on a wooden dining chair with a thin cushion, hands in her lap, and smiles politely at the camera. Then a bearded man drops into a huge padded green armchair, sinks back into the cushions with his arms along the arms of the chair, closes his eyes and lets out a long sigh of relief.

phrases.target: the man in the white T-shirt

4506.question: What is the bearded man doing?
4506.answer: He is sinking into a comfortable armchair.

4508.about: A man in a navy t-shirt and glasses is at a busy airline counter with a trolley piled high with luggage. Holding his passport in his mouth, he heaves one heavy suitcase after another up from the trolley and swings them onto the metal belt beside the desk, finishing with a big black holdall lifted right over his shoulder. The agent behind the desk checks his documents on her screen. At the end he leans on the empty counter and grins, out of breath, with his passport in front of him.
4508.question: What is the man doing?
4508.answer: He is loading his luggage onto the belt.

4509.about: A traveller in a cream polo shirt and sunglasses moves through the steps of arriving. First he lowers a brown leather holdall onto a small counter scale, whose display reads 12.95 while a member of staff scans the tag. Then he takes his boarding pass from a hand across the desk, signs a form at a marble hotel reception with a smiling receptionist, and taps his way through a self-service machine in the terminal. He ends up walking off through the hall carrying his bags.
4509.question: What is the man weighing?
4509.answer: He is weighing a big bag.

4510.about: A young woman in a khaki leather jacket stands in the middle of a busy airport hall under an enormous departures board full of flight times and destinations. She holds a boarding pass in both hands, looks down and reads it carefully, then lifts her head and scans across the rows on the board, frowning slightly as she compares the two. When she finds what she is looking for she smiles, drops her hands and walks away past the other passengers with their trolleys.
4510.question: What is the woman checking?

4511.about: A man in a white polo shirt with sunglasses on his head is being looked after at an airline desk. He lifts a brown leather holdall onto the counter and the agent behind it, smiling the whole time, takes his details, tags the bag and hands him back his passport with the boarding pass tucked inside. He signs where she points, she lifts the tagged bag onto the belt, and he taps the counter and walks off happy while she watches him go.
4511.question: What is the man doing?
4511.answer: He is signing a document at the check-in desk.

4512.about: A young warehouse worker in an orange hi-vis vest, with a pencil behind his ear, holds a clipboard with a printed sheet of rows and boxes on it. He works down the sheet with a red pen, putting a tick in one box after another as he compares it with the cardboard boxes coming past him on a roller conveyor. He then walks along the aisle between tall racks of pallets, reaching up to the boxes on a shelf and marking his sheet again, with forklifts moving in the background.
4512.question: What is the man writing on?
4512.answer: He is writing on a list.

4513.about: A blonde woman in a khaki jacket stands with her suitcase in an airport hall in front of a wall of departure boards listing destinations and times. She reaches up and points at one of the rows, then looks down at her watch to see how much time she has left, opens her passport with the tickets inside and reads them, and finally looks back up at the board again with a satisfied smile.
4513.question: What is the woman holding?

4515.about: A young blond runner in a blue technical T-shirt stands in a sunny park just after a road race, race number 299 pinned to his front. A volunteer in a yellow hi-vis vest lifts a medal on a red-and-white ribbon over his head; he ducks into it, looks down at the medal hanging on his chest and gasps, then clenches his fist and grins into the camera. Other runners walk past behind him under the trees.
4515.question: What is the young man looking at?
4515.answer: He is looking at his new medal.

4519.about: Inside a stone fireplace in a wooden chalet a young man in a cream jumper kneels and builds a fire: he sets split logs upright against each other on the thick grey bed of burnt powder that covers the fireplace floor. The wood catches, flames climb up between the logs, and he sits back on his heels smiling at it. The shot then cuts outside to the same chalet at dusk, snow on the roof and warm yellow windows, with a plume of white smoke rising from the chimney into a deep blue sky.
4519.question: What is the man doing?
4519.answer: He is building a fire in the fireplace.

4522.about: A traveller films herself right through a trip. First she is up on the Great Wall in a turquoise jacket, cap and rucksack, laughing at the camera with the wall snaking over green hills behind her. Then she lies back in a wooden boat drifting down a wide river between tall grey karst peaks in the rain, a fisherman poling past on a raft. Then it is night in a crowded street market under red and yellow neon signs, where she lifts a soup dumpling out of a bamboo steamer with chopsticks and grins at the camera.
4522.question: Where is the woman lying?
4522.answer: She is lying in a boat.

4524.about: An older woman in a red cardigan stands at a floured wooden table making dumplings. Her hands close a round wrapper over its filling and press the edge over on itself into a ridge of little pleats, and she sets each finished one down in neat rows on the tray in front of her, dozens of them. Her family gathers round her under a paper lantern and red decorations: a man, a woman and two small children in red, the children copying her hands. At the end the man lifts the lid off a bamboo steamer and steam billows up over a basket of finished dumplings while everyone leans in and laughs.
4524.question: What is the older woman doing?
4524.answer: She is folding dumplings and arranging them in rows.

4525.about: At a pavement cafe a young man in an olive T-shirt takes a bite of a croissant and it goes down the wrong way: his eyes go wide, he grabs his throat and cannot breathe. The woman next to him jumps up, gets behind him, wraps her arms round his middle and pulls sharply in and up several times while he bends forward over the table. It comes up, he sits back gasping and coughing, and she keeps one hand on his shoulder and holds a glass of water to his mouth while he drinks. Other diners and a waiter look over.
4525.question: What is the woman in orange doing?
4525.answer: She is helping the young man.

4526.about: Inside a polling station. An older woman with red glasses and a flowered scarf stands in a cardboard voting booth with a yellow pencil in her hand and a long printed sheet of empty boxes on the shelf in front of her. She frowns down the sheet, taps the pencil against her lips and looks up while she thinks, then bends over the paper and puts a firm tick in one of the boxes. She straightens up out of the booth with the paper and the pencil and smiles. A queue of other voters waits behind her in the hall.
4526.question: What is the older woman doing?
4526.answer: She is ticking a box on her ballot paper.

4527.about: A street cook in a white cap works at a huge round wooden block in front of a crowd of onlookers. With a broad steel cleaver he chops a bunch of spring onions into rings, then sweeps together the red and green chillies and carrot sticks he has just cut into a pile, then sets a whole white cabbage on the block, halves it and shreds it with fast strokes until a mountain of fine white and green shreds covers the block. Trays of prepared food and a flaming wok stand behind him.
4527.question: What is the cook doing?
4527.answer: He is cutting vegetables with a big knife.

4529.about: A woman in a long cream lace dress pushes open the heavy wooden doors of a small chapel and steps inside. In a large cathedral she takes a lit candle and touches it to the wick of another one on an iron stand until a row of flames burns beside her. Then she walks down the middle of the nave, and the whole stone floor and the pillars around her are covered in patches of red, blue, green and yellow thrown down by the stained-glass windows; she stops among them, looks up at the windows and turns slowly while the patches fall across her white dress.
4529.question: What is the woman looking at?
4529.answer: She is looking up at the windows.

4531.about: A girl films herself going to the pictures. First, hands at the desk tear her printed ticket in half and give her back the stub. Then she walks along a dark carpeted passage with numbered doors opening off it, hers the one marked 2, carrying a big striped tub of popcorn in one arm with the ticket stub held between her teeth, and pushes through the black curtain at the end. Inside the auditorium she drops into a seat in the middle of the rows in front of the huge blank white screen, holds up the popcorn and pulls a delighted face at the camera.
4531.question: What is the woman doing?
4531.answer: She is carrying popcorn to her seat.

4532.about: A woman in a bright patterned headwrap appears in three scenes. First she smiles as she posts a folded white paper through the slot of a grey ballot box in a bright classroom. Then she is in a park with two other women, working a long litter-picker to lift a plastic bottle and other thrown-away rubbish off the grass into the green bags they hold open. Then she stands outside a government building under a row of flags, opens a blue passport, reads it, hugs it to her chest and laughs, and finally walks through a busy city square still holding it.
4532.question: What are the three women collecting?
4532.answer: They are collecting trash in the park.

4534.about: A citizenship ceremony in a bright hall. A row of people stand side by side with their right hands raised, each holding a small Canadian flag, reciting after someone at a lectern. They lower their hands and hug each other. A man in a dark suit wearing a heavy ceremonial chain of office steps along the row and hands each of them a folded certificate tied with a ribbon. A woman in a yellow headscarf takes hers and cries. At the end she raises both arms and cheers while a seated audience applauds.
4534.question: What is the official doing?
4534.answer: He is handing a certificate to a woman.

4535.about: A school classroom during class. Two teenagers lean over an open spiral notebook on a desk; the pages are covered in handwritten algebra. The boy in glasses points at a line with a blue pen and the girl writes. Behind them the room is full of desks. A boy walks up the side of the room and lobs a balled-up sheet of paper at a grey bin by the whiteboard; the students at the desks turn and laugh. A wide shot shows the whole class seated in rows, writing in their books.
4535.question: What is the boy in black doing?
4535.answer: He is throwing a ball into the bin.

4537.about: A small Japanese flat crammed with things. A woman in a yellow apron works along a wooden shelf unit with a spray bottle and a cloth, taking down bottles and folded cloths. The floor around her is covered in clothes and open cardboard boxes; she bends down and packs armfuls of them away. Next she wipes a low wooden table with a blue cloth. The room is then shown from the door: the shelves are empty, the floor is bare, sunlight falls across the boards. She drops onto the sofa on her back, mouth open, done in.

phrases.en: to lie exhausted on the sofa

4537.question: What is she clearing off the floor?
4537.answer: She is clearing scattered clothes off the floor.

4540.about: Four short shots of people cleaning, each built around the kit they use. A woman in yellow rubber gloves pushes a blue sponge in circles through soapy water on a white kitchen worktop. A man in a grey uniform swings a round spin mop on a yellow pole across a glossy office floor while staff work at desks behind him. A window cleaner in a blue hard hat, orange safety harness and white gloves draws a squeegee down a skyscraper pane from a hanging cradle, the city far below. A man in a grey T-shirt bends over a wooden floor in an empty flat with a cloth, buckets and bottles lined up behind him.

phrases.target: the man in the hard hat

4540.question: What is the man outside doing?
4540.answer: He is cleaning a skyscraper window with a squeegee.

4541.about: A bathroom after a haircut. The white basin, the marble counter and the mirror are smeared all over with clippings of black hair; loose hair is stuck to the glass and lies in drifts on the floor. A man in a white vest wipes the counter and the basin with a grey cloth, rinses it under the tap, then wipes the mirror clean in wide strokes. By the end the mirror is clear, the marble is bare and the basin is white again, with a single spray bottle standing on the counter.
4541.question: What is the man doing?
4541.answer: He is wiping the filthy counter with a cloth.

4542.about: A glass-walled office tower. A man in a white kandura and headdress shakes hands with someone in the corridor by a glass door, next to a woman holding a takeaway coffee. Inside a meeting room a woman stands at a large screen showing a grid of bag and shoe designs while four people sit round the table with tablets and paper coffee cups. The man in the kandura holds up a tablet and talks the others through it. A close-up shows a hand sketching a design on a tablet with a stylus. At the end the man stands, leans across the table and shakes hands with a seated colleague while the others smile.
4542.question: What is the man in white doing?
4542.answer: He is sealing an agreement with a handshake.

4545.about: A woman in a pink vest climbs an overhanging limestone crag above a valley. She hangs off small holds by her fingertips with her arms taut and her feet smeared against the rock, a rope clipped to her harness running down below her and a chalk bag on her back. Two friends stand on the ground far below beside a crash pad, watching. She works her way up the bulge, pulls over the top of the block and looks back down, grinning.
4545.question: What is the woman doing?
4545.answer: She is climbing a high rock.

4547.about: A mother and her teenage son with a grey backpack walk up to a small pink and turquoise clinic with a blue cross sign over the door and go in. Inside they stop at a reception counter, where the boy presses a bell on the countertop. They then sit down on yellow plastic chairs against the wall. Beside them an elderly man waits with both hands on a walking stick; a low table in front of them holds magazines. Notices and certificates cover the wall and a round clock hangs above. A doctor in a white coat appears in the corridor doorway and they get up.
4547.question: What is the old man doing?
4547.answer: He is sitting in the waiting room.

4548.about: A rainbow-coloured twin-bell alarm clock stands on a bedside table showing almost ten o'clock, with someone asleep in the bed behind it. The man screws up his face against the pillow. Next he stands in his kitchen holding a striped mug, hair everywhere, staring straight ahead in horror under a big round wall clock. Then a woman in a navy suit and heels stops in the middle of a grand glass-roofed shopping arcade, checks her wristwatch under the huge station clock on the end wall, and runs off through the crowd.
4548.question: What is the woman looking at?
4548.answer: She is looking at her watch.

4550.about: Early morning in a kitchen with low sun through the window. A woman in a cream dressing gown yawns behind her hand and reaches up into the cupboard above the coffee machine, then leans in over the paper filter. She then props her chin on both hands right beside the machine and watches the glass jug, waiting, while the coffee drips in slowly. When the jug is full she lifts it and pours a long stream of dark coffee into a big painted mug, then holds the mug in both hands, closes her eyes and drinks.
4550.question: What is the woman waiting for?
4550.answer: She is waiting for her coffee.

4551.about: A campsite on a pine-fringed lake shore under a blue sky. A blond man in a red fleece stands beside a pitched orange dome tent, grinning, then bends down and crawls in head first. A green tent and another group of campers sit further along the shore. The orange tent sags, then folds flat with only his boots sticking out of the door. He sits up under the collapsed fabric, the whole tent draped over him, and looks round laughing.
4551.question: Where is the man camping?
4551.answer: He is camping by a lake.

4553.about: A woman in lilac pyjamas stands in a sunlit room full of houseplants and draws a pale wooden brush down her very long dark hair, sweeping it forward over her shoulder. She turns, laughing, then kneels on a patterned rug and brushes her golden retriever's coat with the same brush, finishing with her arm around the dog as both look at the camera.
4553.question: What is the woman holding?

4554.about: A marshmallow on a stick chars over a toaster, then a bearded man in a strawberry-print apron turns rows of hot dogs on an outdoor barbecue with tongs. The grill erupts and a wall of orange flame leaps waist-high off the grate; the man keeps turning the sausages while a semicircle of relatives behind him stare open-mouthed.
4554.question: What is the bearded man doing?
4554.answer: He is turning sausages over the flames.

4555.about: A man in an orange puffer jacket and a fur trapper hat rides a small red cable car up a mountain, grinning at the camera as snow-laden conifers slide past the window below. He steps out at the station and boards a larger white gondola, then rides on over a ski slope, with rows of snow-covered pines lining the valley and jagged white peaks ahead.
4555.question: What is the red cable car doing?
4555.answer: It is gliding past the snowy pines.

4556.about: An open-plan office. A laptop on a white desk shows a rising stock chart while two people type either side of it. A woman in a light blue shirt walks over with a takeaway coffee, leans across the desk and points at the chart on a man's screen, talking and laughing; he sits back and watches. The whole team then gathers round the desk in a half circle, standing and sitting, and applauds him while he grins at the laptop.
4556.question: What is the whole team doing?
4556.answer: They are praising the man at the laptop.

4557.about: A log cabin at night with snow at the window and a wood stove burning. An elderly man with a white beard, in a cream cable-knit cardigan and grey woollen socks, sits back in a wing armchair with his feet on a footstool. He shakes out a tartan blanket and spreads it over his legs, picks up a mug in both hands and sips, and a golden retriever climbs up and lies across his lap. He leans back with his eyes closed, smiling.

phrases.en: to curl up on his lap

4557.question: What is the retriever doing?
4557.answer: It is curling up on the man's lap.

4558.about: A dim living room strung with fairy lights at dusk. A young man sits on a sofa wrapped in a striped knitted blanket, crying, holding a mug of tea in both hands. A friend beside him puts an arm round his shoulders and talks quietly to him. Two more friends sit down on either side, then a fourth, and they all lean in and hold him while he keeps crying with the mug in his hands.

phrases.en: to clutch a mug of tea
to wrap him in a blanket

4558.question: What are the friends around him doing?
4558.answer: They are hugging him to show support.

4559.about: A room lit by blue and orange fairy lights. A red-haired young man sits on a sofa under a striped blanket, crying, holding a yellow mug in both hands. A friend rests a hand on his shoulder, then a young woman sits down beside him and rubs his arm, and two more friends close in from behind. They wrap their arms around him together in one tight group hug, faces pressed against his shoulders, while he goes on crying.
4559.question: What are his friends doing?
4559.answer: They are consoling their weeping friend.

4560.about: A rowing eight on a still river lined with willows, filmed from the bow. Eight rowers in matching navy kit and sunglasses drive back and forth in exact time, their oars dipping and lifting together and throwing up splashes on both sides. The cox sits facing them in the stern with headphones and a microphone. A cyclist passes along the towpath. At the end one rower punches a fist into the air.
4560.question: What is the crew doing?
4560.answer: The crew is rowing past a willow.

4561.about: A misty river at dawn with low sun through the willows. A rowing eight comes straight at the camera; the woman at the front, in a navy cap with a headset microphone at her mouth, shouts calls at the crew behind her, her mouth wide open. The rowers drive through the stroke in time with her, the boat surging and throwing spray off the blades. At the end the crew punch their fists up together.
4561.question: What is the woman in front doing?
4561.answer: She is shouting commands at the crew.

4562.about: A red-haired woman in a wool jumper stands on an open moor of purple heather, holding an open brass pocket compass close to her face and frowning at the needle. She crouches down and holds it flat in both palms until it settles, then straightens up, sets her jaw and strides off across the heather. The last shot shows her at sea, gripping a large ship's compass in its binnacle with the horizon behind her.
4562.question: What is the woman looking at?
4562.answer: She is looking at a compass.

4563.about: A marble ceremonial hall with a Turkish flag and rows of schoolchildren in uniform singing. A woman in a maroon suit and white cotton gloves carries a huge leather-bound book with a gold emblem and gilt corners to a wooden lectern and sets it down. She opens the heavy cover and turns the pages, showing hand-written calligraphic text inside ornate coloured borders. The last shot holds on the open book standing upright with a red wax seal on the stand in front of it.
4563.question: What is the woman doing?
4563.answer: She is leafing through a huge law book.

4569.about: A man with long hair tied back cooks in the open side doorway of a camper van parked above a surf beach, the turquoise sea and breaking waves filling the background. Strips of red and yellow pepper sizzle in a frying pan on the gas hob; he stirs them with a spatula, then lays two pink fish fillets into the pan beside them and presses them down. He lifts a small saucepan and pours sauce over the fish, and finally sets the finished plate of fish and peppers down on the counter.
4569.question: What is the man doing?
4569.answer: He is frying fish in a pan.

4570.about: Three kitchens in a row. A bearded man in a vest tosses sliced peppers and carrots out of a wok over a roaring blue flame in a food truck above a turquoise sea. Then a woman in an apron stir-fries at a street stall in a crowded market street, ladling in stock until a wall of orange flame leaps out of the wok and she laughs behind it. Finally a man in a white double-breasted chef's jacket with his name stitched on the chest sets a sprig of microgreens on a plated dish of pork, carrots and purée in a stainless steel restaurant kitchen, then steps back and looks at it.
4570.question: Where is the woman cooking?
4570.answer: She is cooking on the street.

4571.about: A fishing beach with a big wooden boat sitting high on timber skids. A crowd of villagers, men and women of all ages, put their shoulders and hands against the hull and shove it forward down the rollers towards the sea, straining with their heels dug into the sand. An old man in a blue shirt walks ahead of them hauling on a wooden beam and shouting the count. The boat runs down the skids and reaches the water, and the group ends up in a circle in the shallows, hugging each other and cheering.
4571.question: What are the people doing?
4571.answer: They are pushing a big boat.

4572.about: A woman in a mustard blouse and red glasses sits alone at a long desk in an empty lecture theatre, with a takeaway coffee cup beside her. She works through a pile of exam papers with a red pen, drawing corrections across a sheet, then putting it down and pulling the next one over. Each time she looks up the two piles either side of her have grown taller, until they tower well above her head and hide her behind them. At the end she sits back, staring up at the towers of paper with her mouth open, spare red pens scattered across the desk.
4572.question: What is the woman doing?
4572.answer: She is correcting a pile of exam papers.

4573.about: A busy diner with red vinyl booths, white tablecloths and a violinist playing between the tables. An elderly woman in a grey suit sits at a booth and slides a folded napkin across the cloth. A man in a blue shirt and tie with a gold watch heaves a brown leather briefcase up onto the table opposite her. The two of them then sit behind raised menus, glancing sideways at each other. The camera pulls back to show the long tablecloth is draped over a wheelbarrow parked at the table, and under the cloth the barrow is heaped with banded bundles of cash; they reach across and shake hands over it.

phrases.target: the man with the gold watch

4573.question: What are the man and woman doing?
4573.answer: They are shaking hands across the table.

4575.about: A reading room in a library, with tall wooden shelves of books and other students working at the tables behind. A young woman in a beige cardigan sits at a table with an open book, a pen, her glasses and a water bottle in front of her. She presses her hand over her mouth, her eyes watering and her face screwed up, then bends forward over the table and coughs hard into her fist and into the crook of her sleeve, several times. The students behind her keep reading.

phrases.target: the woman in the white shirt

4575.question: What is the woman in front doing?
4575.answer: She is coughing into her hand.

4576.about: A large hall with long tables covered in stacks of paper. A young woman in a green sari with a lanyard sits at one table, a pen in her hand, lifting sheet after sheet off a tall stack and marking a tally sheet on a clipboard in front of her. The camera pulls back to show dozens of people down both sides of the tables doing the same, each behind their own towers of paper, with observers standing along the walls. At the end she raises a hand in the air.
4576.question: What is the woman in green doing?

4579.about: A woman in a denim jacket sewn all over with national flag patches grins into the camera from behind a spinning school globe. The shot cuts to her in front of the Eiffel Tower in Paris with both arms thrown up, then to a selfie on the back of a scooter riding past green rice terraces in Bali, then to her standing on the crest of a desert dune at sunset with her arms spread wide, and finally jumping on the dune towards the camera.
4579.question: What is the woman doing?
4579.answer: She is opening her arms wide.

4582.about: A sunny back garden with a family party going on: picnic tables set with food and cups, and grown-ups and children all over the lawn. A boy and a blonde girl run towards each other across the grass and hug tightly, laughing into the camera. They then stand back to back, chins up, and an adult lays a flat ruler across the tops of their two heads to see which of them is taller. Other children run past behind them.
4582.question: What is resting on their heads?
4582.answer: A ruler is resting on their heads.

4583.about: A floodlit five-a-side pitch at night. A player in a pale blue kit runs onto the ball, then suddenly pulls up and drops onto the grass, rolling onto his side and grabbing the back of his lower leg with both hands, his face screwed up. A man in a grey training vest runs on, kneels beside him, takes hold of his ankle and lower leg and pushes the foot back to stretch the muscle out while the player grimaces and clenches his fist. Team-mates stand watching in the background.
4583.question: What is the kneeling man doing?
4583.answer: He is stretching the player's calf.

4584.about: Early morning on a wide sandy beach. A newly hatched sea turtle drags itself down the wet sand towards the water, and behind it a long double line of flipper prints runs back up the beach, with more hatchlings strung out along the same track. A woman in a khaki shirt and a red headband kneels behind them with both hands pressed to her mouth, delighted. In the last shots the white foam of a wave washes up over the sand and reaches the turtles.
4584.question: What are the turtles leaving behind?
4584.answer: They are leaving a trail in the sand.

4585.about: A woman in a red beret, a striped top and dark jeans, carrying a baguette under her arm, walks from one side of a narrow Paris street to the other over the white stripes on the road, past a red-awninged cafe. The shot then cuts to a wide boulevard in front of the Arc de Triomphe, where she walks the whole width of the road with a crowd of other people while the light is green and the cars wait, and steps up onto the far side.
4585.question: What is the woman doing?
4585.answer: She is clutching a baguette on the crossing.

4586.about: A Paris street corner with a red-awninged cafe and a cyclist waiting. A woman in a red beret and a striped top, holding a baguette, walks towards the camera along the broad white bars painted across the road, with the pedestrian light green beside her. The shot then cuts to the wide bar-painted crossing in front of the Arc de Triomphe, filled with people walking across in both directions, and she walks up the middle of it towards the camera.
4586.question: What is the woman carrying?
4586.answer: She is carrying a baguette across the crosswalk.

4587.about: A man in a red jacket films himself from the handlebars as he rides. First he sits on his bike on a sandy track between green fields, looking up at a level-crossing sign against a blue sky. Then he is stopped at the edge of a village road, one hand on the handlebar, watching cars go past a traffic light. Finally he is at a big city junction under tram wires, with traffic lights, cars turning and a crowd of people waiting on the far pavement, his mouth open in surprise.
4587.question: What is the cyclist looking at?
4587.answer: He is looking at the cars.

4589.about: A Japanese city street. A woman in a coral trouser suit with a white shoulder bag walks across the white-barred crossing towards the camera while a black van waits at the red light and the walk signal shows green; other people on foot cross the side street behind her. The camera then rises high above a huge scramble junction, showing her alone in the middle of the painted bars, and finally the same junction with hundreds of people on foot streaming across it in every direction while the cars stand still.
4589.question: What is the woman in coral doing?
4589.answer: She is striding across the pedestrian crossing.

4591.about: A woman in a straw visor pulls a suitcase up a metal gangway towards an enormous white passenger ship, its many decks of balconies and its orange lifeboats filling the frame behind her. She walks along the ship's wooden promenade deck with a keycard on a lanyard, someone dives into the pool on the top deck between the two funnels, and she eats at a buffet beside the panoramic windows with green cliffs sliding past outside. At sunset she stands at the deck rail with her suitcase as the ship sails through a bay of rocky islands.
4591.question: What is the woman pulling?
4591.answer: She is pulling a suitcase onto a ship.

4592.about: Sunset in a vineyard. A hand squeezes a bunch of dark grapes until purple juice runs down the wrist and arm and drips into a crate below. A woman in a red top and an older man tip a crate of grapes into a big wooden vat. Then bare feet come down into the grapes: close shots show the soles and toes pressing and turning in the fruit, the ankles and lower legs stained purple, and finally the two of them stand in the vat and stomp up and down together, laughing, with the rolled-up jeans above their bare feet.
4592.question: What are they doing in the vat?
4592.answer: They are crushing grapes with their bare feet.

4593.about: A young man in a navy tracksuit walks down a long, bright hospital corridor on two metal crutches, with a grey walking boot strapped onto one foot. He swings himself forward step by step towards the camera. Behind him a nurse in white scrubs follows with a clipboard, watching him walk. Windows line one wall and handrails run along both sides of the corridor.
4593.question: Where is the man walking?
4593.answer: He is walking in a hospital.

4594.about: A young woman in a party dress cries hard, tears running down her cheeks as she presses a tissue to her face. The camera pulls back to show she is in the middle of a group of friends in evening clothes, all of them crying and laughing at the same time. They press in on each other, arms round shoulders and backs, until the whole group ends up in one tight knot of people hugging.
4594.question: What are the friends doing?

4595.about: A young man in a green hoodie sits on a sofa in a living room at night, sobbing. His face is wet, his mouth is pulled down and his eyes are screwed up. He holds a tissue box on his lap, and the sofa around him is buried under a mound of crumpled white tissues. He pulls one tissue after another, presses it to his eyes, and drops it onto the pile.
4595.question: What is the man doing?
4595.answer: He is crying and clutching a tissue box.

4596.about: A young woman with her hair in a messy bun sits curled on a sofa under a checked blanket, crying. Her eyes and the skin around her nose are red and swollen. She lifts a white tissue to her face, covers her nose with both hands and blows it, then lowers the tissue and goes on crying with the blanket clutched to her chest.
4596.question: What is the woman doing?

4598.about: In a coffee shop lined with shelves of brightly coloured cups, a red-haired woman in cat-eye glasses orders at the counter. A hand slides her a normal rainbow-striped mug of coffee and she lifts it and grins. Then a far bigger mug appears, and a bigger one still, until she is gripping a pastel-striped mug the size of a bucket with both hands, eyes wide and mouth open, its handle as thick as her wrist.
4598.question: What is the red-haired woman doing?
4598.answer: She is clutching a huge mug.

4600.about: At a money-changer's booth in a busy covered bazaar, a moustached man in a grey shirt and dark waistcoat holds out a thick bundle of banknotes in both hands over a glass case. He counts through a stack of purple notes, then spreads dozens of notes into a wide fan across the counter, laying different currencies side by side. A young woman in an orange beanie watches with her mouth open in amazement, and at the end he passes a handful of notes over to a hand reaching in from the camera side.
4600.question: What is the woman staring at?
4600.answer: She is staring at a fan of banknotes.

4601.about: A woman in a cream jumper works on a grey corner sofa in a bright Scandinavian living room. She smooths the seat with both hands, then carries cushions over one at a time - mustard, pink, teal, patterned - and sets them along the back of the sofa in order, straightening each one as she goes. When the row is finished she steps back to look at it, then drops backwards onto the cushions and lies there with her arms spread.
4601.question: What is the woman doing?
4601.answer: She is arranging the cushions on the sofa.

4606.about: A young man in an olive jacket films himself with a selfie stick as he travels. First he stands on a stone bridge at sunrise, the river orange behind him and a domed church and a tall gothic tower on the far bank. Then he stands in a crowded square looking straight up at the face of an astronomical clock set into a stone tower, with pigeons bursting into the air around it. Finally he sits in a wood-beamed beer hall, lifts a litre tankard, drinks and laughs with the men beside him.
4606.question: Where is the clock?
4606.answer: The clock is on a tower.

4607.about: Inside a brewery a blonde woman in a denim shirt and apron pulls a beer. She holds a glass tankard under the tap and lets the beer run in, then works the handle so a thick white head builds up over the rim. Two full tankards stand on the steel drip tray. Behind her rise tall, round brewing vessels of polished reddish-brown metal that glow under the lights. She carries a tankard over to three waiting friends and the four of them clink glasses over an old wooden barrel.

phrases.target: the man in the green shirt

4607.question: What are the big tanks made of?
4607.answer: The big tanks are made of copper.

4608.about: A run of street-dance scenes. A breakdancer flips upside down on a sunny city plaza inside a ring of people who clap and film him. Then women in wide rainbow-coloured folk skirts spin in the middle of a street while onlookers press in on both sides. Next about ten dancers move as one down the aisle of a shopping centre, with shoppers gathering along the sides. Finally the camera lifts to show hundreds of people filling a whole city square at dusk, all dancing the same steps in rows that run back to the buildings.
4608.question: What is the crowd doing?
4608.answer: The crowd is dancing in the square.
